schema_note: At build time, use the named $defs to expand inputSchema and outputSchema for each MCP tool. Each emitted schema is self-contained, has object root type, and includes its transitive definitions. Object permissions, invariants and byte limits are further constrained in the companion contracts.

operations.name: dashboard_get
operations.description: Publication counts, current send, migration state and outstanding setup checks.

operations.name: settings_get
operations.description: Read all editable publication settings and their revision.

operations.name: settings_update
operations.description: Replace settings atomically. Verify sending identities before use.

operations.name: health_get
operations.description: Read prerequisites, provider quota, queue lag, storage, feedback freshness, pause and recovery status.

operations.name: dispatch_set
operations.description: Pause or resume after readiness checks, with an audited reason.

operations.name: operators_list
operations.description: List allowlist entries and bound identities.

operations.name: operators_add
operations.description: Invite an exact verified email.

operations.name: operators_remove
operations.description: Remove membership and end its grants, preserving a final bound operator.

operations.name: grants_list
operations.description: List delegated grant metadata.

operations.name: grants_revoke
operations.description: Revoke a client grant immediately.

operations.name: audit_list
operations.description: Page redacted command or object audit history.

operations.name: subscribers_list
operations.description: List or search audience with a filter and stable cursor.

operations.name: subscriber_get
operations.description: Read a subscriber and their current eligibility.

operations.name: subscriber_history
operations.description: Page an individual's consent, provenance and suppression history.

operations.name: subscriber_tags_set
operations.description: Replace tags without altering consent.

operations.name: subscriber_suppress
operations.description: Stop further marketing deliveries and record a reason.

operations.name: subscriber_erase
operations.description: Erase personal data and retain only the documented minimum suppression record.

operations.name: segments_list
operations.description: List saved audience definitions.

operations.name: segment_preview
operations.description: Preview counts and a page of results for an unsaved audience filter.

operations.name: segment_create
operations.description: Save a named segment.

operations.name: segment_update
operations.description: Change a saved segment revision.

operations.name: segment_delete
operations.description: Remove a saved segment, preserving previous campaign snapshots.

operations.name: templates_list
operations.description: Find available template revisions.

operations.name: template_get
operations.description: Read email HTML, plain text and template metadata.

operations.name: template_create
operations.description: Create a named HTML and text template.

operations.name: template_update
operations.description: Save a new revision of the template.

operations.name: issues_list
operations.description: Find editions by title and status.

operations.name: issue_get
operations.description: Return the current draft, metadata and digest.

operations.name: issue_create
operations.description: Create an editable draft with a stable issue ID.

operations.name: issue_import
operations.description: Create or revise an edition from a staged site bundle. Include the current revision on replacement.

operations.name: issue_update
operations.description: Save editor changes as a revision.

operations.name: issue_versions
operations.description: List previous draft revisions and digests.

operations.name: issue_version_get
operations.description: Return a selected complete revision.

operations.name: issue_restore
operations.description: Restore an earlier revision as a new draft.

operations.name: issue_render
operations.description: Preview exact HTML, plain text, headers, warnings and digest with sample recipient substitutions.

operations.name: issue_archive
operations.description: Archive an editorial draft without deleting its sent history.

operations.name: archive_bundle
operations.description: Prepare an archive handoff with stable IDs for the host site's authorized publication workflow.

operations.name: archive_verify
operations.description: Check the configured public origin and feed for this release and record the result.

operations.name: campaigns_list
operations.description: List active and historical campaign receipts.

operations.name: campaign_get
operations.description: Show the current state and delivery totals.

operations.name: send_test
operations.description: Send a labeled proof to a configured test recipient or local sink.

operations.name: send_prepare
operations.description: Freeze and review candidate audience, issue digest, counts, schedule and budget. No mail is dispatched.

operations.name: send_commit
operations.description: Accept the reviewed plan once, now or at its due time.

operations.name: send_cancel
operations.description: Cancel the scheduled send or stop remaining recipient work.

operations.name: attempts_list
operations.description: Inspect individual attempts and filter ambiguous deliveries.

operations.name: attempt_resolve
operations.description: Close an ambiguous delivery after reconciliation. Never resend from an unknown result.

operations.name: report_get
operations.description: Page issue, link, acquisition or cohort metrics with window, units, labels and denominators.

operations.name: export_create
operations.description: Snapshot authorized records or reports into a private downloadable export.

operations.name: file_begin
operations.description: Start a bounded upload and bind object purpose and owner.

operations.name: file_write
operations.description: Append a base64 chunk at its exact byte offset. Matching replays are safe.

operations.name: file_finish
operations.description: Verify length, digest and content type before sealing an immutable object.

operations.name: file_read
operations.description: Read an authorized file as bounded base64 chunks. Sensitive import/export kinds also require admin.

operations.name: import_prepare
operations.description: Validate staged files, mappings and provider evidence without adding sendable readers or mail jobs.

operations.name: import_commit
operations.description: Apply the reviewed checksums and suppression-first mapping with a durable receipt.

operations.name: migration_status
operations.description: Read source and destination counts, cutoffs, eligible-set digest, delta freshness and discrepancies.

operations.name: migration_reconcile
operations.description: Compare a staged delta and ledger against recorded baselines. Emit a private discrepancy file.

operations.name: jobs_list
operations.description: Page jobs visible to the caller, with their original scope checks.

operations.name: job_get
operations.description: Read progress, diagnostics and any result asset for an authorized job.

operations.name: job_retry
operations.description: Retry eligible transient failed work from its checkpoint; uncertain mail attempts stay held.

operations.name: reader_info
operations.description: Read public signup copy metadata and published host archive/feed destinations.

operations.name: reader_subscribe
operations.description: Request double opt-in with the same generic acknowledgment and abuse controls as the form.

operations.name: reader_resend
operations.description: Request another confirmation subject to cooldown and eligibility.

operations.name: reader_confirm
operations.description: Exchange the confirmation token after a deliberate choice by its holder.

operations.name: reader_unsubscribe
operations.description: Opt out using the matching reader proof; supports idempotent repetition.
